title: They offered the sultan a fortune for one man's ruin | Folio 5 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
But at a court, praise draws enemies. A rival named Bu Sahl Zawzani, a clever and bitter man, went to the sultan with a suggestion. Bu Nasr was rich, he said. If the sultan pressed him, three hundred thousand dinars could be squeezed out of him for the treasury. Masud listened to the offer. And then he answered. He refused. He would not ruin a servant like that.

The full story: Folio 5: The Secretary Who Kept the Sultan's Secrets — on our channel and on every podcast app.
